queries: Tesla Model Y rear touchscreen factory 2025 2026 features rear passengers
turns.answer:
The Tesla Model Y rear-seat touchscreen is an entertainment and climate-control display located on the back of the center console, between the front seats.

What can it do?

The factory-installed 8-inch rear screen supports:

Entertainment: Video streaming and games

Climate control: Rear air conditioning and airflow

Seat controls: Rear seat heating and supported seat adjustments

Bluetooth headphones: Connect up to two pairs

Media: Music playback controls

Tesla introduced this display with the refreshed 2025 Model Y. However, not every 2026 trim includes it: Premium and Performance models have it, while current Standard trims do not.
